_readme: One element of a picture brought to life while the PHOTO view is showing.
Keyed by puzzle id. Untagged pictures animate not at all.
effect     ripple | glow | shimmer | breathe | twinkle
cells      the cell ids the effect is clipped to (its silhouette)
amplitude  how strongly it moves, default 1
This file is the source of truth, not the puzzle JSON: tools/mapify.mjs
rewrites puzzles/<id>.json from scratch on every bake, so a tag written
there by hand would be wiped by the next `npm run seed`. writePuzzle()
reads this file and injects the `animation` field instead.
Use `node tools/tag-animation.mjs <id>` to pick the cells by eye.
Underscore-prefixed keys (like this one) are ignored.
